terminals.name: postgres
terminals.description: Local PostgreSQL 16 on localhost:5433 (user/db lgi/lgi_tools), kept in the foreground so it stays up for the whole session. Schema + EVE SDE data are provisioned by install.sh.

terminals.name: next-dev
terminals.description: Waits for Postgres, then runs the Next.js dev server on http://localhost:3000. Use this rather than `pnpm dev:all` (Docker + a logged-in convex dev). Pair with the convex-dev terminal for Atlas/mapper.

terminals.name: convex-dev
terminals.description: Anonymous local Convex backend on http://127.0.0.1:3210 (CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous). Required for Atlas mapper probes and `convex run --deployment local`. Do not point the app at a hosted Convex URL.
